items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And, uh, let's see, Ed. Uh, clarinet, let's see who.

ctx.x: We got him up in Baton Rouge, remember Ralph?

Yeah. And, uh, Eddie Atkins was playing trombone. Oh, yeah. Eddie Atkins. And, uh, let's see, Joe, Joe was on the trumpet. And, uh, let's see, Ed. Uh, clarinet, let's see who. He had a clarinet, uh, C. Now he had, uh, Willie, Willie Caput, uh, Chris Minor, and Pop Foster. And he had a clarinet, I think. Uh, uh, I don't know if he was just for his name now. Uh, Lorenzo Teale. and he had a clarinet Lorenzo Teal Lorenzo Teal
Did they have any name for the band? Is it Joe's band? Magnolia band
